verdict.rationale: Multi-currency billing is a fair question for a subscription billing platform, but the evidence never documents billing customers in their local currency or setting per-currency price points. The only currency reference is RevRec's general "multi-currency support" for revenue recognition. That is an adjacent reporting feature and does not show consolidated home-currency reporting of local-currency billing. Regional payment gateways (SagePay, PayPal, Wirecard) do not establish currency pricing either.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency
